subject: Access artifact custody declaration + SCIM snapshot request
messages:
From: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@helixcare.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SCIM snapshot and custody note request

Hi Tessa,

We're preparing for our SIG review next week and the auditor asked for a short chain-of-custody note for the SCIM/entitlement extracts you shared earlier. Specifically: a) a single CSV export with the last full sync (timestamped) and b) a short declaration that describes who ran the export, where it was stored, and how long HelixCare can expect Redwood to retain the artifact.

Can Redwood provide:
- a SCIM full-sync CSV (latest) with attributes: email, externalId, groups, role_claims, lastModified
- a custody declaration PDF we can include with our evidence bundle that states retention and redaction practice for the exported file

If possible we'd like the SCIM snapshot and the custody doc by EOD Tuesday PT so we can upload to the compliance portal. Let me know if this timeline is realistic.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Evans
Head of IT Compliance | HelixCare

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Evans <jordan.evans@helixcare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM snapshot and custody note request

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide both items. Quick notes on scope and approach so we align with your auditor's expectations: 

1) SCIM extract: we will produce a single CSV exported from the provisioning service containing the exact attributes you listed. We'll include a header row and a small manifest that documents the provisioning connector and sequence id.

2) Custody declaration: Redwood will prepare a one-page PDF that includes: who performed the export (engineer + manager), export timestamp (UTC), storage location (S3 path + access controls), retention period for the export (30 days by default for evidence requests), and our redaction approach for PII in evidence artifacts. If HelixCare requires longer retention, we can provide an exception with audit logging.

3) RBAC context: we'll also attach a short role-claim mapping snapshot (human readable) showing which Redwood roles map to HelixCare groups so auditors can see least-privilege alignment. This is not the full entitlement dump but a condensed mapping.

I'll ask Karthik to run the export and to drop both files to our secure drive. Laura — can you also confirm the retention exception path if HelixCare needs >30 days?

Target delivery: Tuesday 2026-05-12 by 14:00 PT. If anything slips we'll flag immediately.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Jordan / team —

Confirmed: Redwood will issue the custody declaration PDF and we can extend retention to 90 days for evidence artifacts when requested by customers for audit purposes. Standard practice remains 30 days; retention extension requests are tracked via SEC-RETENT and require an approval ticket (I've created SEC-RETENT-1093 and added Jordan as a watcher).

I've drafted the custody declaration (attachment stub: access-custody-declaration-v1.pdf) — it includes: export operator, storage path, retention window (90 days for HelixCare per approval), encryption at rest details, and pointers to redaction/PII minimization steps.

Next steps for Jordan: confirm you want the 90-day retention for this evidence bundle and we will deliver the final PDF plus the CSV manifest to the compliance portal link you provided.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Trust & Safety
